policyReview.message: Champlain’s bachelor’s degree requirements set no degree-wide upper-level minimum. Their only upper-level rule is 15 credits of 300-level or higher major courses at Champlain. This plan’s named 300-level or higher major courses with no outside option total 24 credits, so it meets that rule.
